nodes.text: Only for a branch this session created or was asked to work on (the ticket's branch): if it already has a failing CI run (gh run list --branch <branch> --limit 1), start with it: read its log (gh run view <id> --log-failed), fix the root cause, commit and push that branch. On any other branch skip this step, and never push another branch. Never push to main or master.

check.command: gh run list --commit "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" --json status,conclusion --jq 'if length == 0 then "none" elif all(.[]; .status == "completed" and (.conclusion == "success" or .conclusion == "skipped" or .conclusion == "neutral")) then "completed success" else map("\(.status) \(.conclusion)") | join(", ") end'

agentDone.goal: CI is green for the latest push: name each run of this commit and its result, or say that no CI ran for it. (A flaky test or the environment cannot be fixed here: say so and change nothing; the loop then ends at its limit and you report it.)

nodes.text: Wait for this commit's CI runs: list them with gh run list --commit $(git rev-parse HEAD). If none shows up after a minute, say there is no CI for this commit. Otherwise wait for each with gh run watch <id> --exit-status, run with a long Bash timeout (up to 10 minutes), and don't end your turn while a run is in progress. On a failure read gh run view <id> --log-failed and say whether it is a real failure, a flaky test or the environment.

For a real failure, fix its root cause. Never disable, skip or weaken a test or a check. Commit and push this branch; never push to main or master. For a flaky test or the environment, change nothing and say so.
Tell the user what still fails in CI and why, and what you tried. If no CI run ever showed up for this commit, say that instead: nothing was checked.
